en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed and Ibn Abu Umeyr, both together from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Muhammad Bin Muslim and Zurara, and others besides these two, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding
the wergild. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is one hundred from the camels, and there are neither Dinars in it nor Dirhams, nor (anything) other than that’.
